name: Jump In The Hole [ UPD 4 ]
desc:
Welcome to Jump In The Hole!

Dive into an exciting adventure where you jump into mysterious holes that transport you to new worlds! Collect adorable pets, unlock secret places, and see how far you can go with your friends.

How to Play:

🕳️ Jump into Holes 🕳️
🐾 Collect Unique Pets 🐾
🌍 Discover New Worlds 🌍

Don’t forget to join our group and like the game for more updates!
